capabilities: Create Eisenhower matrices as regular Markdown notes with quadrant headings
Add sticky notes by answering Urgent? and Important? questions
Drag and drop sticky notes between quadrants and reorder them
Filter sticky notes by tag chips
Complete, hide and clear sticky notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Text outside task items in the matrix file is not kept when the matrix saves.
problem: Obsidian has no visual urgent-important board, so prioritizing tasks means reading plain task lists instead of dragging them between quadrants.
summary: Eisenhower matrix plugin that renders a note as a sticky-note board with draggable tasks across Do, Schedule, Delegate and Eliminate quadrants.
